wholePhysicalScope: Named native 25-point footprint, including the south porch vertices and curved apse.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the round brick nave, flared metal roof, square belfry, chancel, apse, porch and west block. Near levels resolve the open belfry, masonry bands, gabled entrance and standing seams.
limitations: The model represents the exterior as seen in April 2009. The mapped perimeter fixes component layout. Roof heights, pitch, masonry detail and partly obscured elevations are estimated from two cleared views.
Original public elevation samples are preserved. Churchyard paving and individual doorway thresholds are approximate.
